title: dam doctor answer
description: What dam doctor prints on standard output with --json or --toon. With --fix it first creates the starter config.lua and the store where each is missing. It exits 1 when a check that ran is an issue, and prints no error document.

command.description: The command that produced the report.

created.description: With --fix: the path of each file dam doctor created, empty when it created none. Absent without --fix.

checks.description: Each check that ran, in the order the report shows them.

needs_attention.description: Each issue, then each warning, as the closing section numbers them. A check with rows lists each row that needs attention as <check> for <remote>: <detail>, and never its own detail.

name.description: The check, by the name dam doctor takes, or the part, by the name dam test takes.

result.description: What the check found; not_run when it could not run.

detail.description: What the check found, in words.

advice.description: What to do next, or null.

rows.description: One row for each remote, in config order, or empty for a check that has none. The check's result is the worst of its rows, from issue, warning, ok to not_run, and its detail counts them.

config.description: On the config check: the path of config.lua, or null when there is none.

secrets.description: On the config check: the path of secrets.lua, beside config.lua, or null when there is none.

warnings.description: On the config check: each token dam ignores or holds disabled, and why.

last_run.description: On the sync check: the last-run file the schedule writes on each run. A warning here makes the check a warning and adds <check>: <detail> to needs_attention.

path.description: The path of the last-run file.

written.description: When the file was last written, or null when there is none.

result.description: warning when the schedule is installed and the file is missing or older than 10 minutes, ok when it is newer, not_run when the schedule is not installed.

detail.description: When the file was written, or that the schedule has not run since then, in words.

advice.description: What to do next, or null.

name.description: The remote this row is about.

result.description: What the check found for this remote.

detail.description: What the check found for this remote, in words.

advice.description: What to do next, or null.
